purpose: Preserve/recover the already-preregistered SS0 candidate geometry without selecting any candidate from canonical-browser D0 scores.
candidateIdentityPolicy: GT is the existing :gt-local identity. WRONG identities are exactly SS0 Pareto-dominating WRONG candidate IDs plus the historical final WRONG, deduplicated by candidateId. No candidate may be added or removed from canonical-browser scores.

historicalFineStage.use: Restores pose/radius fields omitted by the normalized SS0 finalist rows for East Cross, General Shrine historical, and Fang Xu. Values come from the historical finalWinner object whose x/y and D0 vector exactly equal the corresponding frozen SS0 finalist row.

ownerFinalCoordinateGap.evidence: The owner post-acquisition evidence and SS0 normalized final rows preserve final candidate ID, GT distance, angle, scale/radius and D0 vector but not final x/y; the accepted CI artifact contains only identity freeze, evidence, report and acceptance JSON.
ownerFinalCoordinateGap.boundedRecoveryRule: Before canonical D0 scoring, recover only x/y by requiring a unique current production-search geometry candidate with exact historical angle (1e-6) and historical GT distance (0.05 px). Retain historical angle and scale/radius. Do not use canonical D0 score, rank, acceptance or proximity-to-legacy-score to choose the candidate. If the invariant match is not unique, baseline adjudication fails. The recovered x/y must then be frozen explicitly in the lineage amendment so future authoritative runs do not repeat this recovery search.
